National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Mr S K Pal, has joined as Director (Finance) on Board of the Company w.e.f. February 01, 2013.

Spurt in Volume : Substantial increase in trading volumes have been observed in National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "We have no additional information of this nature to share with you for the time being. Increased volume may be due to certain extraneous reasons of which the company has absolutely no knowledge".

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that the Ministry of Urban Development (MOUD) has appointed Mr Rakesh Misra, Director General, CPWD as Government Nominee Director on the 'Board' of National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited vice Mr S K Mittal, former Director General of CPWD, w.e.f. November 15, 2012. Now, the company is processing for induction of Mr Rakesh Misra as director on the 'Board' as per the requirements of the laws.
National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Standalone Financial Results for the period ended September 30,2012.

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that the Ministry of Urban Development (MOUD) has appointed Mr S.K Mittal, Director General, CPWD as Government Nominee Director on the 'Board' of National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited vice Ms Sudha Krishnan, JS&FA, MOUD w.e.f. October 04, 2012. Now, the company is processing for induction of Mr S.K.Mittal as director on the 'Board' as per the requirements of the laws.

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Corporation has been granted 'MINI RATNA' Category-I Status on the Basis of its Performance upon Fulfiling the Criteria Prescribed by Department of Public Enterprises. Thus Enabling the Company to Enter into Joint Ventures, Set Subsidiary Companies, Overseas Offices with Certain Conditions.
National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the proceedings of Annual General Meeting of the Company held on September 08, 2012.

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that the Annual General Meeting of the Company is scheduled to be held on September 08, 2012. The Register of Members and Share Transfer Books shall remain closed from September 01, 2012 to September 08, 2012 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of Annual General Meeting and for declaration of Dividend.
National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Standalone Financial Results for the period ended June 30,2012.

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 29, 2012 has recommended a final Dividend of Rs.3.50 per equity share of Face Value of Rs.10 each, amounting to Rs.42 Crore.
National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Standalone Financial Results for the period ended March 31,2012.

National Buildings Construction Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange that Shri Ajay K. Garg, Director (Finance) has Ceased to be the Director on the Board of the Company on Completion of his Five Year Tenure From April 19, 2007 to April 18, 2012.
